reasons.claim: Three eligible species within 250 m: Alectoria sarmentosa (VU lichen, nearest 128 m, 2018 record, 10 m uncertainty), Tricholoma matsutake (VU fungus, 146 m, 2023, 250 m uncertainty) and Hydnellum scabrosum (VU fungus, 146 m, 2023, 250 m uncertainty). All are forest-associated, site-bound, with continuity-forest/old-tree/forestry-disturbance threats. The rubric gives HIGH.
Wider ring has 25 eligible species and 42 site-bound forest NT species within 1000 m, including EN Usnea longissima (392 m, 2026, 5 m uncertainty) and EN Pytho kolwensis (437 m, 250 m uncertainty).
Completed felling overlaps only 1.3% of the 5.82 ha polygon (a 2012 felling), so it is not already felled. Effort is high (98th percentile; 73 records from 68 species within 250 m).

uncertainties: Two of the three within-250 m eligible records have 250 m coordinate uncertainty, larger than the site's 136 m equivalent radius, so their exact position relative to the polygon is unclear. They pass the tool's ring rule only at the 250 m ring.
The nearest Alectoria sarmentosa record (128 m) is from 2018; the species has later records (latest 2026) not necessarily at that distance.
No records are inside the polygon.
not_established: That any recorded species occupies the felling polygon today.
Absence of records inside the polygon does not mean absence of species.
Nothing here says the site is safe to fell or that felling is unlawful.
next_action: Reviewer should locate the Alectoria sarmentosa, Tricholoma matsutake and Hydnellum scabrosum records relative to the polygon and survey the stand before felling begins.
